applicability: Drama3 standalone native-computation runtime on one B300
Only each cited microbenchmark, fixed-state diagnostic or complete service trial
limitations: Campaign remains INCONCLUSIVE and optimization is paused
Individual completed gate failures do not complete the all-concurrency acceptance matrix
Repository summary inspected; external raw traces and runtime artifacts not rerun or rehashed
No root cause inferred from client accounting or cross-screen timing subtraction
attribution: Issue #10 diagnostic lessons, including runtime 47c3d2ec4e3406d8a71fccc3cb4967783c2650f5; revisit checks are current suggestions

findings.direction: Qualify fused tower projections and longer decode groups at service scope
findings.reason: The recorded isolated checks could be correct or faster while full-service throughput did not improve. Multi-step decode also deferred new admissions.
findings.revisit_when: Check active batch sizes through admission and drain, then time the complete path with sampling and codec under the same service workload.

findings.direction: Check ATen cuBLAS workspace sharing when codec capture changes WER
findings.reason: The fixed-request controls initially passed despite service WER failures in both arms. In a later bounded replay, private codec capture passed the tested service control while shared capture failed; the runtime guarded dedicated capture.
findings.revisit_when: Preserve the private/dedicated capture setup and matched controls. Establish WER and throughput for the proposed overlap and concurrency separately.

findings.direction: Require the complete C64 continuation gate for production prefix reuse
findings.reason: The graph/state checks and both full quality groups passed, while the complete C64 continuation gate failed. The recorded production default stayed off.
findings.revisit_when: Keep all returned work and final drain in the replay. Inspect the actual schedule and GPU critical path before proposing another production setting.

findings.direction: Reset private padding rows before an A/A state comparison
findings.reason: The initial prefix-reuse comparison paired distinct physical padding histories. The reported discrepancy was in a private slot, and an identical-input control superseded that setup.
findings.revisit_when: Recreate all physical input rows with identical histories and finish A/A before interpreting any later state mismatch.
findings.bounds: Initial Drama3 prefix-reuse harness comparison, later replaced by matched-input controls.

findings.direction: Require physical traffic and a timing win before enabling transparent VMM compression
findings.reason: VMM compression passed native correctness and lifetime checks, yet its fixed three-body screen missed the frozen timing gate. The runtime did not promote it.
findings.revisit_when: Confirm the workload is bandwidth-sensitive and measure physical bytes or effective compression together with the complete timed body.

findings.direction: Measure complete kernels before retaining a producer scale-tile cache
findings.reason: The producer scale-tile cache did not meet its complete-body reduction gate. The screen stopped before model or service promotion.
findings.revisit_when: Run a bounded screen for a materially different shape or resource constraint. Include a matched complete kernel as the control.

findings.direction: Revisit FP8 SIMT only with an improved mapping or cost case
findings.reason: The fixed eight-lane mapping was stopped by CPU/AOT analysis before runtime evaluation. No accelerator timing supports a hardware-wide conclusion.
findings.revisit_when: Supply a different lane mapping or a supported cost model before deciding whether a native run is warranted.
